summary: Assignable PDFs for education: a teacher marks up a PDF, assigns it to students, and each student's copy is merged and scored. BifrOSt has PDF form models and a PDF app, but no assignment, taker, scorer or merge model. iPadOS 15.4 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: The PDF form model reads fields; it does not carry assignment markup.
No element identity for PDF markup.
No identity registry for document editors.
The PDF app shows and marks up PDFs; it is not an assignment view.

gaps: No assignment, per-student copy or scoring model.
No merge or identity model for shared PDF markup.
